title: PID Water Level Control System
description: Developed a precision water level control system using PID methods based on Arduino Uno and Nano. Responsible for the full electronic schematic design.

title: ESP32 Stair-Climbing Robot
description: Built a prototype stair-climbing robot controlled by an ESP32 microcontroller. Focused on the design, structural planning, and assembly of the mechanical components.

title: Fetal Heartbeat Simulator for Calibration
description: Created a fetal heartbeat simulator for medical calibration using an Arduino Uno R3 and a modified oil-filled relay actuator to precisely simulate heartbeats. Handled mechanical design and assembly.

title: Superlab Network & IoT Infrastructure
description: Implemented network infrastructure including VLAN segmentation and DHCP, integrated with an IoT-based RFID identification system.
